description: Calculate the maximum leverage that keeps a position within a drawdown limit, from account size, max acceptable drawdown, and asset daily volatility. Edge cases: accountSize and volatilityPct above zero; maxDrawdownPct above 0 and at most 100; mmr 0 to 0.1 (default 0.005). A planning figure from the numbers you give, not a limit set by an exchange. Not covered: gaps and fat-tail moves beyond the volatility you state, exchange maximum leverage and tiers, funding, and fees. Use when user asks "what leverage does a 10% drawdown limit allow on BTC?" or "what leverage fits a 3% daily volatility and a 10% drawdown limit?". Returns: maxLeverage (maxDrawdownPct / (volatilityPct + mmr x 100), rounded down to 0.1, never below 1x), marginAtRisk (accountSize x maxDrawdownPct / 100, in USDT), safeMargin (USDT) and liquidationBuffer (percent). maxDrawdownPct and volatilityPct are percents (10 means 10%); mmr is a fraction (0.005 is 0.5%).

maxDrawdownPct.description: Maximum acceptable drawdown as percentage, e.g. 10 for 10%

volatilityPct.description: Expected daily price volatility as percentage, e.g. 3 for 3%

name: workflow.run_max_leverage
title: Max Leverage
